scope: All 192 source POLITY rows intersecting MS 2000 were inventoried. This is not a list of 192 independent countries, nor independent historical/geometric certification of every row.

greece.issue: False rejection of two isolated tangent hole pairs. No new points or boundary repair; source MultiPolygon is retained.

jordan.label: Ürdün Krallığı
jordan.finding: A monarchy is not inherently an anachronism in MS 2000. Jordan is retained.

newIdentityFindings.name: Federal Republic of Somalia
newIdentityFindings.finding: Source uses the federal-republic title over 1960–2023; the UN documents the new federal transition in 2012. The full source interval needs review.

newIdentityFindings.name: Kingdom of Bahrain
newIdentityFindings.finding: The 1973–2023 source interval predates the 2002 constitutional kingdom title. Do not present the full interval as a kingdom.

newIdentityFindings.name: Eswatini
newIdentityFindings.finding: The Eswatini name is backdated to 1969/1973/1976; the UN records the change from Swaziland in 2018. The separate 2024 row is not excluded by this finding.

newIdentityFindings.name: Serbia-Montenegro
newIdentityFindings.finding: Source applies the Serbia-Montenegro name from 1992; the UN records the renaming of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia in February 2003.

newIdentityFindings.name: People's Republic of Angola
newIdentityFindings.finding: The old People's Republic title is extended through 2023 and 2024. Contemporaneous Angolan UN statements in 2000 use Republic of Angola. Do not invent the exact name-change date from this evidence.

newIdentityFindings.name: Libyan Arab Republic
newIdentityFindings.finding: The old Republic title is carried across 1976–2013. Contemporaneous 1977 UN treaty records use Libyan Arab Jamahiriya. The full title/period mapping needs review.
